fields.Name: MJ.BizApps.Orders.Progress.Supersede
fields.Description: Replace the latest posted progress observation on a percentage-of-completion line. Orders.RecordProgress writes a new observation that names the one it replaces, reverses the replaced observation's recognition on its own date, and posts the new catch-up. Nothing is edited; the replaced row stays Posted and immutable. Held by the Orders Revenue Supervisor role, on top of MJ.BizApps.Orders.Progress.Attest, which every attestation needs. Without this row, supersede is refused.
